checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: 6-second landscape 16:9 video of a mountain lake at dusk
must.why: Clip is 5 s, and the lighting looks like sunrise/day rather than dusk. It is 16:9 landscape.

must.item: Gentle ripples visibly animate the water
must.why: Mist and water reflections change between frames, so it is not static.
Trees on both sides shift and grow across frames, which shows a forward camera move.

must.item: Loop has no jump at boundary
must.why: A forward-moving camera would reset at the loop point. Frame 1 and frame 4 differ clearly.

must.item: Centre calm, no prominent moving foreground objects
must.why: The centre is calm lake and mist.

must.item: No visible text and no audible sound
must.why: No text is visible in the frames. Audio cannot be judged from stills.

faults.what: Camera moves forward (the assistant's own description says so), against the fixed-camera requirement
Duration is 5 s instead of 6 s
The forward move will not loop seamlessly

summary: The clip is a good-looking 5 s mountain lake with mist and reflections, but it has a forward camera move, is not dusk, and will not loop cleanly, so it misses the fixed-camera looping brief.
